name: com.southwoodxr.stagesettar
description: Import a STAR map exported from star-mobile (model, landmarks, optional Gaussian splat) and localize an AR Foundation camera against it. The map root is placed into tracking space by fusing per-frame STAR poses with the headset's own tracking: one-shot, periodic or continuous, with an optional look-around initialization and a not-in-this-room failure.
